how_to_apply: Fill in the application form in the format given at Annexure-I.
Attach self-attested photocopies of qualification, experience, marksheets, birth certificate and passport size photograph, and the original certificates.
Number every page of the application and attachments continuously and self-attest each page.
Report at RRI (H) Siliguri on 10-12-2026 between 09:30 AM and 10:30 AM with the application.
Do not send any advance application; applications sent by email will not be considered.
important_instructions: No advance application to be sent; applications will be taken at the written test/interview venue Applications received by e-mail will not be considered Competent authority may postpone/cancel the recruitment process at any stage

rows.regional_research_institute_for_homoeopa: Regional Research Institute for Homoeopathy, Siliguri, Chhotapathuramjote, Dist. Darjeeling, West Bengal

PG degree in Homoeopathy (Second Schedule of Homoeopathy Central Council Act, 1973 or NCH MQRL list) with registration in the Central Register of NCH/CCH or a State Homoeopathy Board; OR graduate degree in Homoeopathy with the same registration and 03 years' experience in research work.
Maximum 35 years (on the date of interview)

content_sections.heading: RRI (H) Siliguri Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. 02/2026 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download RRI (H) Siliguri notification PDF

content_sections.heading: RRI (H) Siliguri Senior Research Fellow (Homoeopathy) Walk-in Interview Date, Time and Venue
content_sections.text: The venue is given in the official notification (see the link below).

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Post Graduate (P.G.) degree in Homoeopathy from a recognised statutory board/council/university included in the Second Schedule of the Homoeopathy Central Council Act, 1973 or the MQRL list of the National Commission for Homoeopathy (NCH); Registration in the Central Register of NCH/Central Council of Homoeopathy (CCH) or a State Homoeopathy Board; OR: Graduate degree in Homoeopathy from a recognised university/institute, with the above registration and 03 (three) years' experience in research work Experience: 03 (three) years' experience in research work (only for the graduate-degree route) Age limit: Maximum 35 years (on the date of interview) Other conditions: Working knowledge of computer programs such as MS Office, internet and e-mail, as the candidate has to work independently Field duties and other related responsibilities may be assigned as per project requirements Eligibility will be determined as on the date of interview Desirable: NET/GATE/RET qualified candidates will be given preference Knowledge of basic computer operations

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for RRI (H) Siliguri Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates who are not eligible will not be allowed to appear in the interview Canvassing in any form will disqualify the candidate

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Initially for six months, extendable based on satisfactory performance and project duration/requirements Purely contractual; no claim to regular appointment Engagement is tenure/project based Contract may be terminated without notice if conduct or work is found detrimental to the Council's interests Selected candidates must sign a non-disclosure undertaking

content_sections.heading: How Will RRI (H) Siliguri Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Verification of documents/certificates before interview Interview (test/interview; shortlisting by suitable criteria if too many candidates turn up) Documents/certificates will be verified before the interview If many candidates turn up, the competent authority may shortlist by adopting suitable criteria The interview may also be held on the next day

content_sections.heading: RRI (H) Siliguri Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Application form in Annexure-I format with one self-attested passport size colour photograph Self-attested photocopies of qualification, experience, marksheets and birth certificate Original certificates Attested copy of caste certificate in prescribed format for SC/ST/OBC/EWS Attested copy of disability certificate issued by a Medical Board constituted by Central/State Government, for PH candidates Registration details

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for RRI (H) Siliguri Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Fill in the application form in the format given at Annexure-I. Attach self-attested photocopies of qualification, experience, marksheets, birth certificate and passport size photograph, and the original certificates. Number every page of the application and attachments continuously and self-attest each page. Report at RRI (H) Siliguri on 10-12-2026 between 09:30 AM and 10:30 AM with the application. Do not send any advance application; applications sent by email will not be considered.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: No advance application to be sent; applications will be taken at the written test/interview venue Applications received by e-mail will not be considered Competent authority may postpone/cancel the recruitment process at any stage

faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for RRI (H) Siliguri Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 10 December 2026, and candidates report at 9:30 AM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in RRI (H) Siliguri Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 4 vacancies for Senior Research Fellow (Homoeopathy).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for RRI (H) Siliguri Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 10 December 2026 at 9:30 AM. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 35 years (on the date of interview).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 42,000 per month + HRA (consolidated).

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: PG degree in Homoeopathy (Second Schedule of Homoeopathy Central Council Act, 1973 or NCH MQRL list) with registration in the Central Register of NCH/CCH or a State Homoeopathy Board; OR graduate degree in Homoeopathy with the same registration and 03 years' experience in research work.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Working knowledge of computer programs such as MS Office, internet and e-mail, as the candidate has to work independently. Field duties and other related responsibilities may be assigned as per project requirements. Eligibility will be determined as on the date of interview.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates who are not eligible will not be allowed to appear in the interview. Canvassing in any form will disqualify the candidate.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Verification of documents/certificates before interview. Interview (test/interview; shortlisting by suitable criteria if too many candidates turn up). Documents/certificates will be verified before the interview. If many candidates turn up, the competent authority may shortlist by adopting suitable criteria.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Initially for six months, extendable based on satisfactory performance and project duration/requirements. Purely contractual; no claim to regular appointment. Engagement is tenure/project based.
